checks.statement: Adapt or replace the navigation bar at larger breakpoints with an appropriate rail or drawer.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Resizing: Adapt or replace the navigation bar at larger breakpoints with an appropriate rail or drawer.

evidence.result: The isolated component specimen has no application policy or surrounding route state to satisfy the condition “When moving beyond compact layout.”.

implementation.notes: The source instruction is “Adapt or replace the navigation bar at larger breakpoints with an appropriate rail or drawer.” under “When moving beyond compact layout.”. This requires app-level layout, routing, destination hierarchy, or product-selection context that this component specimen does not own. Disposition applies only to that integration condition.

checks.statement: Allow the bar to grow vertically while retaining default padding; labels may wrap, must remain fully visible through 2× text size, and may truncate only beyond 2×.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Text scaling and truncation: Allow the bar to grow vertically while retaining default padding; labels may wrap, must remain fully visible t

evidence.result: Vertical labels are measured with the existing shared ResizeObserver; the surface grows while retaining token padding. Horizontal destinations use equal intrinsic grid columns centered within the surface instead of stretching between the window edges.
Chromium: 22 assertions pass at 2x text size for compact vertical and medium horizontal layouts, checking every label and horizontal overflow.

implementation.notes: The preview still selects orientation explicitly. This does not implement automatic breakpoint selection of horizontal versus vertical items.

checks.statement: Differentiate selected items with a filled icon and bold label; use outlined icons and medium labels when unselected. If no filled icon exists, use a heavier icon.

checks.statement: At medium breakpoints, use horizontal items; keep their width and centering consistent, retaining the same padding at each breakpoint.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the specific Presentation rule: At medium breakpoints, use horizontal items; keep their width and centering consistent, retaining the same pad

evidence.result: Explicit horizontal items now retain intrinsic widths and centered spacing as the bar grows, with text scaling support. An adaptive bar composition that selects horizontal items at the medium breakpoint is still absent.

implementation.notes: The old assessment conflated the missing adaptive composition with absent horizontal width/centering styles. Preserve the explicit orientation control; add a distinct adaptive example if this integration is implemented.

checks.statement: Keep destination ordering and selection behavior consistent.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Navigation items: Keep destination ordering and selection behavior consistent.

evidence.result: The click handler clears aria-current from all items in the navigation group, selects the clicked destination and emits its label; the bar renders a stable Home/Files/Saved order.

implementation.notes: The specimen keeps item order stable and permits one current destination at a time.
